title: Regrouped-order guard in main() is tautological — the SystemExit is unreachable
evidence:
+    families = {}
+    for n in SPRITE_ORDER:
+        families.setdefault(SPRITE_SPECS[n][0], []).append(n)
+    if [n for fam in families.values() for n in fam] != SPRITE_ORDER:
+        raise SystemExit("sprite build order diverged from SPRITE_ORDER (the sprites.odin pin)")
detail: families is an insertion-ordered dict built by iterating SPRITE_ORDER, so flattening it necessarily reproduces SPRITE_ORDER; this guard can never fire.
recommended_fix: Delete the check or test something real, e.g. that each family's sprites are contiguous in SPRITE_ORDER or that every family .blend file exists.

title: Shadow offset documented as proportional (∝ footprint) but floored at constants
evidence:
+	dx := max(f32(2.5), dst.width * 0.08)   // proportional down-right offset
+	dy := max(f32(3.0), dst.height * 0.10)  // (the constant light-direction cue)
...
+| Shadows | NEVER baked — the game draws the sun-cast ink ellipse in-engine (25–33% ink, offset down-right ∝ footprint) |
detail: max() floors the offset at 2.5/3px; the diff's own scale note puts houses (~21.6px wide) below the floor, so their offset stays constant, contradicting the ∝ docs.
recommended_fix: Document "proportional with a 2.5/3px floor" in the comment, README, and spec — or drop the floor if strict proportionality is the contract.
